content: Ãngur saša okkol edde mirazdar
Toi Isaye hitarare mesal kahani loi hota howa šuru goijje:

content.text: "Ekzon manuše ekkan ãngur keti goijje, ar hiyanor sairo ḍakottu gíra diyore butore šoraf banaibolla ugguwa gãt tiyar goijje, edde ekkan usol fahara gór bainde. Bade hite hoekzon sašar hãse hiyan lagaiyore bidešot giyegoi.
Gular ainda zẽtte aišše, hite hitar gular bag loianibolla ekzon gulamore oi saša okkolor hãse defeṛaiye.
Kintu hitara he gulamware doriyore maijje edde hali hate dũrai diye.
Tafore hite ar ekzon gulamore hitarar hãse defeṛaiye. Hitara hitare o mata sai mari agat goijje edde ofoman goijje.
Hite tarfore o aro ekzonore defeṛaiye. Hitara hitare mari felaiye. Tarfore hite aro bout zonore defeṛaiye, kintu hitarar butottu hoekzonore mara dora goijje, ar hoekzonore marifelaiye.
"Heṛe defeṛaibolla hitattu basi aššilde šude ekzon, hiba oilde hitar nizor adoijja fut. 'Hitara ãr futore oile ijjot goribo' hen bafiyore šešottu hitare hitarar hãse defeṛaiye.
"Kintu saša okkole ekzonore ekzone hodde, 'Ite mirazdar, aiyo, ãra itare marifelai, toi miraz ãrar oi zaiboi'.
Hitara hitare dori marifelaiye. Tarfore ãngur ketir baire felai diye.
"Toile ãngur ketir girose ki goribo, hosai? Hite aibo edde he saša okkolore marifelaibo ar ketigan o oinno kiyore difelaibo.
Tũwara kitabor ei lekagun no foro ne:
"'Ze fattorguware raz mistiri okkole batil goijje:
hiba i beši dorhari fattor oi uiṭṭe.
Iyan Mabud nizor ham,
ar hiyan ãrar sukot kub beši tajjuiffa.'"

content: Hetunot he dormiyo neta okkole Isare dorifelaibolla kušiš goijje, kiyollahoile hitara buzifaijjil ze Isaye mesal kahanigan hitarar berudde hoiye. Kintu hitara mainšore ḍoraiye, hetolla hitara zar zar bote te te giyegoi.
Hazna diyar babute suwal
Tarfore hitara Isar hotat doribolla hoekzon Foroši edde Herudiyo okkolore Isar hãse defeṛaiye.

Toi hitara Isar hãse aišše edde hodde, "Ustad, ãra zani õne hamiša soiyir uzu tako, ar mainše ki mone goribo hin õne forba no goro, kiyollahoile õne honokiyor suk saiya muk saiya kissu no goro, kintu Allar rastar babute ziyan soiyi hiyan šikka do.Toile Romor badšare hazna diya iyan ṭik ne naki beṭik? Ãra diyum ne naki no diyum?"
Kintu Isaye hitarar bonḍami sail buzi fariyore hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ãre fãndot feilaito kiyolla sešta goror? Ãlla ekkan foiša ano edde ãi hiyan ekka sai!"

content: Hitara ekkan foiša anidiye. Bade Isaye fusar goredde,

content.text: "Iyanor uwore har sóbi edde nam ase?"

content: Toi hitara hodde, "Romor badšar"
Toi hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Toile zin zin Romor badšar hin Romor badšare do, ar zin zin Allar hin Allare do!"

content: Ei hotar uwore hitara ammuwak oiye.
Mora okkol uwafes zinda
Tarfore Sadduki okkol Isar hãse aišše, zara hoito heṛe hono uwafes zinda nai, toi hitara Isar hãse suwal goijje.
"Ustad, nobi Musaye ãralla leki giye, hono ekzonor bái zodi fuwain no owaite bouwore raki mori zagoi, toile hitar báiye he bouwore biya goribo, edde nizor báiyolla bongšo baraibo.
Ehon, hãt bái ase ek górot. Foilawaye biya goijje, kintu hono fuwain no raka abostat mori giyegoi.
Bade hibare dusorawaye biya goijje, kintu hite o hono fuwain no raka abostat mori giyegoi. Ar hendilla ekkui bafe tiserawaye goijje.
Hitara hãtozon honokiyottu fũwain no o. Šeše he mayafuwawa o morigiyegoi.
Henoile uwafes zindar šomot, hitara zẽtte uwafes zinda oibo, hitarar butottu hiba har bou oibo? Hibarede hãtozon beggune biya goijjil."
Isaye hitarare zuwab diye,

content.text: "Tũwara búl, kiyollahoile tũwara no buzo Allar kalam otóba no buzo Allar šoktire.
Mora okkol zẽtte zinda oi uṛibo, hitara biya no goribo ar biya o diya no oibo, hitara behostot firista okkolor ḍoilla.
Kintu mora okkol uwafes uṛar babute tũwara zolonto zúwãr kahani Torah šorifot no foro ne? Allaye Musare hodde, 'Ãi Ibrahimor Allah, Isakor Allah, edde Yakubor Allah.'
Hiba mora okkolor Allah no, kintu zinda okkolor. Tũwara beši ḍõr búl fõtot aso!"

content: Foila hokumgan
Hitarar ekzon aleme heṛe aiyore hitarar barabari fuinne edde Isaye hondilla bala zuwab diyede hiyan buzi fariyore Isar hãse giye edde fusar goijje, "Hokum beggunor butore honnan beši zoruri?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Beši zoruri oilde iyan, 'Funo Israili okkol! Ãrar Mabud Allah, Mabud oilde ek.
Tũi tũwar hár dil, hár mon hár foran, hár šokti, diyore Allah Mabudore muhabbot goro.'
Ar dusoragan oilde iyan: 'Ar tũwar ḍen gór bam gójjare nizor zani muhabbot goro.' Inottuwaro ar hono ḍõr hokum nai."

content: He aleme hibare hodde, "Ustad, bala hoiyo. Õne soiyi hoiyo ze Mabud oilde ek, Hiba sara ar oinno honokiye nai.
Ar hár dil, hár buddi edde hár šokti diyore hibare muhabbot gora edde ḍen gór bam gójjare nizor zani muhabbot gora oilde aro beši muilloban, hár fura-kurbani okkol edde kurbani okkolottuwaro."
He aleme hondilla giyani zuwab diye hiyan Isaye dekiyore, hibaye hitare hodde,

content.text: "Tui Allar raijjottu beši dure no."

content: He oite honokiye ar hono suwal goitte himmot no gore.
Mosi honnuwa
Isaye dórmogóror uṛanot šikka dedde šomot, hibaye hodde,

content.text: "He alem okkole ken gori Mosire Daudor fuwa hoi fare?
Daud nize, Pak Ruhur duwara elan goijje:
"'Mabude ãr Malikore hodde:
"Ãr ḍen ḍakottu boi,
zetodin ãi tor dušmon okkolore
tor ṭengor tole no raki."'
Daude nize hibare Malik ḍaker, toile hiba ken gori Daudor fuwa oi faribo?"

content: Ek ḍor mainšor dole kušir sãte hibar hota fuinne.
Alem okkolor berudde hũšiyari
Ar šikka dedde šomot hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Alem okkolottu hũšiyar! Hitara lamba lamba hor findi beraito sa edde haṛot bazarot mainšor solam,
muzolišhanar usol zagat edde mela šobar barik zagat buware foson gore.
Hitara rari okkolor gór okkol dokol gore, ar mainšore dehaibolla lamba gori duwa gore. Hendilla mainše bisaror din bout beši šasti faibo."

content: Gorib rarir dan
Toi Isaye dórmogóror dan bakšur ḍake sarmottu boiyore, mainše hitarar nizor nizor ṭiyare dan bakšut rakedde saiye. Bout tuwangor okkole beši diye.
Kintu ekzon gorib rari maya fuwa o aišše edde duiyan šoṛo tamar foiša raikke, zinor muillo šude ho ek fiya.
Toi Isaye sahabi okkolore hibar hãse ḍaikke edde hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, oinno zara ei dórmogóror dan bakšut raikke, hitara beggunottuwaro ei gorib rari mayafuwawaye beši raikke.
Kiyollahoile hitara beggune hitarar beši šombottittu dan bakšut raikke, kintu hibaye hiba obafi oi bade o, hibattu foran basaibolla zin aššil, hin beggun di felaiye."
